findings.description: The Lambda function embeds a plaintext AWS access key ID (AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE) and secret access key directly in its environment variables. These long-lived credentials are stored in Terraform state and readable by anyone with lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration, exposing AWS access to anyone who can read either.
The function uses the nodejs12.x runtime, which is end-of-life and no longer receives security patches, leaving known vulnerabilities unaddressed in the execution environment.
